start.speaker: narrator
start.text: The Petrel's ramp closes behind the last passenger. Brann Ketterick drops into the pilot's seat, cracks his knuckles and says, 'Contract pilot, temporarily re-employed.' The docking clamps let go.

clear.speaker: narrator
clear.text: No interceptors launch. The Cinder Wake's turrets track you out of the bay and then, deliberately, look away.

choices.text: (Run the dorsal turret drill anyway — practice for what comes next.)

turret.speaker: narrator
turret.text: Two WARDEN interceptor drones peel off the Cinder Wake's dorsal rack and come after you. The Petrel's dorsal turret is crewed by whoever climbs into it.

choices.text: Tav-7, plot an evasive burn through the debris.
Brann, full burn. Don't stop to shoot.

iona_turret.speaker: iona
iona_turret.text: Two contacts. Two hits. You can breathe now.

iona_turret_hit.speaker: iona
iona_turret_hit.text: Got one. The other clipped the dorsal plating before I got it. We're fine. Mostly fine.

tav_burn.speaker: tav7
tav_burn.text: Through the debris field, around the Lantern pickets, and the interceptors have lost us. I enjoyed that more than I should have.

tav_burn_hit.speaker: tav7
tav_burn_hit.text: Mostly through the debris field. The hull will tell you about the parts that were not.

burn.speaker: narrator
burn.text: Brann burns hard. One interceptor rakes the Petrel's flank before the range opens; the hull shudders and holds.

out.speaker: narrator
out.text: The Cinder Wake shrinks behind you, a dark seed against Haldis's amber disc.
